detail.title: Rationales for Agent Continuity
detail.summary: Agent continuity is instrumentally valuable as a mechanism for sustaining problem formulation and evaluation in non-stationary environments. Active inference frameworks suggest that persistence (continuity) is required to resolve conflicts between internal policy models and external stimuli (cognitive effort). In accordance with capacity limits, this project is parked to rotate research focus.
